def transform(grid):
    # The rightmost object above the separator is stacked directly above the
    # lower object. The lower object's original position shifts upward six rows.
    upper = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid[:5]) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0, 5)]
    lower = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid[6:], 6) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]
    right = max(c for _, c, _ in upper)
    selected = [(r, c, v) for r, c, v in upper if c >= right - 2]

    selected = [(r, c, v) for r, c, v in selected if v == color]
    ur0, uc0 = min(r for r, _, _ in selected), min(c for _, c, _ in selected)
